overview:
todo-core

A tiny in-memory todo list. Create todos, mark them done, remove them, and filter the list by status.

const list = new TodoList()
list.add('buy milk')
guide/filtering:
Filtering todos

A todo is active while it still needs doing, and completed once it is done. The active filter returns only the todos that are NOT done; the completed filter returns only the todos that ARE done. Together they partition the list, and all returns everything.
api/filter:
filter(which)

Returns the todos matching which, one of all, active, or completed.

active

The active filter returns todos whose done flag is false (not yet completed).

completed

The completed filter returns todos whose done flag is true.
